row.ink: The words stand above the line, extending left over the end of reconstruit. A separate dark curved guide runs beneath the inserted phrase, bends over the cap region of Pi, descends beside its left stem, and has an upward curl at its right end. This is a physical insertion guide, not a cover tilde over Pi. The accepted fragment marks the insertion but gives neither the raised placement nor this curved stroke. The proposed TikZ preserves the relative attachment and curve without changing the words or the groupoid letter. The native half supplies the complete inserted words; the existing tight crop supplies the guide geometry.

row.place: Pour ceci paragraph, interlinear pi-one hyphen and hook before bitorseur (inventory E14)
row.ink: The pi-one and its hyphen are raised over the gap before the initial b and extend above its beginning. Beneath the prefix is a separate hook-shaped dark guide: it begins at the upper left, curves right, and descends nearly vertically immediately before b. It has no arrowhead. Neither the guide nor its physical relation to the word is reproduced by an inline inserted wrapper. The initial b is heavily retraced, but no distinct cancelled predecessor can be separated, so no deletion is invented. Existing action and definition crops stop on opposite sides of the complete insertion locus; one new tight crop was made for this newly unresolved feature.
